fallback: Please ask a question about the LocalServe app, its services, providers, bookings, payments, messages, or invoices.
fallback_roman_urdu: Meherbani karke LocalServe app, services, providers, booking, payment, messages ya invoice ke mutaliq sawal poochein.

entries.answer: Hello! I can answer questions about LocalServe services, providers, bookings, payments, messages, and invoices.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Salam! Main LocalServe services, providers, bookings, payments, messages aur invoices ke bare mein sawalon ka jawab de sakta hoon.

questions: is app ka kya maqsad hai
what can I do in LocalServe
entries.answer: LocalServe is a demo app for finding local service providers and managing service bookings, messages, and invoices.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: LocalServe aik demo app hai jahan aap local service providers dhoond sakte hain aur bookings, messages aur invoices dekh sakte hain.

questions: how do I find a service provider
where can I find a plumber
entries.answer: Open Services, choose a category, and browse the available local providers. Categories include Plumber, Electrician, AC Repair, Carpenter, Painter, and Cleaner.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Services kholein, category chunein aur available local providers dekhein. Categories mein Plumber, Electrician, AC Repair, Carpenter, Painter aur Cleaner shamil hain.

questions: AC repair wala mil sakta hai
entries.answer: The demo includes Plumber, Electrician, AC Repair, Carpenter, Painter, and Cleaner categories. Open Services to browse providers.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Demo mein Plumber, Electrician, AC Repair, Carpenter, Painter aur Cleaner categories hain. Providers dekhne ke liye Services kholein.

questions: how do I book a service
how can I schedule a provider
provider ko kaam ke liye kaise bulaun
entries.answer: Open Services, choose a category and provider, tap Book Now, then select a date, time, and service address and confirm the booking.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Services kholein, category aur provider chunein, Book Now dabayein, phir date, time aur service address select karke booking confirm karein.

questions: how do I cancel a booking
I no longer need the booking
entries.answer: Open Bookings, select the booking, and use its cancel option. Whether it can be cancelled may depend on its current status.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Bookings kholein, apni booking select karein aur cancel option use karein. Cancel hona booking ke current status par depend kar sakta hai.

questions: do I pay before or after service
entries.answer: LocalServe demo payments are cash after the service. In-app card or online payment is not available.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: LocalServe demo mein service ke baad cash payment hoti hai. App ke andar card ya online payment available nahi hai.

questions: where do I see the service price
how much will a provider charge
entries.answer: Open a provider's profile or service listing to review the price shown there. Confirm the final price with the provider before work begins.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Provider ki profile ya service listing mein dikhayi gayi price dekhein. Kaam shuru hone se pehle final price provider se confirm karein.

questions: how do I message a provider
mujhe provider se baat karni hai
entries.answer: Open Messages to view your chats, or open a provider's profile and tap Message to start a conversation.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Apni chats dekhne ke liye Messages kholein, ya provider ki profile khol kar Message dabayein.

questions: how do I download an invoice
get a receipt for my booking
entries.answer: Open the completed booking and choose Download Invoice to get its receipt.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Mukammal booking kholein aur receipt hasil karne ke liye Download Invoice chunein.

questions: how can a provider set availability
provider apna time kaise set kare
entries.answer: Providers can manage their open time slots from the Availability calendar in the app.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Providers app ke Availability calendar se apne khali time slots manage kar sakte hain.

entries.answer: Choose Customer or Provider during registration, verify your email, and complete your profile. Providers also add their category, price, and service area.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Registration mein Customer ya Provider chunein, email verify karein aur profile mukammal karein. Providers apni category, price aur service area bhi add karte hain.

questions: how do I check my booking status
entries.answer: Open Bookings to check the latest status and details of your service request.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Apni service request ka latest status aur tafseel dekhne ke liye Bookings kholein.

questions: can the assistant book a service for me
kya assistant meri booking kar sakta hai
kya tum meri booking dekh sakte ho
can you access live provider information
entries.answer: The assistant only answers questions using LocalServe help information. It cannot access your account, see live provider or booking data, or perform actions.
entries.answer_roman_urdu: Assistant sirf LocalServe ki maloomat se sawalon ke jawab deta hai. Yeh aapka account ya live provider/booking data nahi dekh sakta aur koi action nahi kar sakta.
